_meta.shape: Array of { rank, discordId, username, avatar, points } sorted by points (descending). Identical shape to the live /api/leaderboard route and the Africp get_leaderboard tool output.
_meta.source: Synthetic. Real leaderboard data lives in the User Mongo collection and is only served by the authenticated /api/leaderboard route.
_meta.notes: Static fallback for the wc-prediction-strategy Agent Skill. The discordId values are placeholders (all-numeric, not real Discord snowflakes) and usernames are clearly labeled `demo_player_N`. Offline agents MUST treat this as illustrative only. Reasoning that depends on identifying specific players should add an explicit caveat to the user. Real installs with a live endpoint will fetch live data from /api/leaderboard.
